text:
cass: Quick ask  need a manager-facing one-pager for an incoming hybrid senior PM (confidential project). Must include day0 logistics + a clear 30/60/90 with measurable milestones managers can use for review. Can we keep it manager-focused (not hire-facing) and put a tiny DM template for day0?
omar: Yep. Manager checklist should include security clearance steps up front (extra PT access), who to notify for NDA materials, and an explicit review with legal at day7.
ting: IT/infra notes: pre-provision accounts to avoid delays. We can push the image `rwi-secured-2026` and pre-enroll VPN + SSO groups. Badge: security desk pre-approve needed for after-hours access.
it-ops: Laptop pickup windows: Wed 9-10am (Bldg B) & Thu 4-5pm. For shipping, mark envelope "Confidential" only if legal signs off; otherwise use standard packaging.
cass: DM template manager can copy-paste (day0):
```
Hi <name> 00% excited to have you. Pick up laptop: Wed 9-10am (Bldg B lobby) or we can ship. Reply with preference. Bring ID for visitor badge. First day 9:30am: quick setup with IT + 30-min intro with the product team. Youll get invites for SSO and security training shortly. \\— <manager>
```
omar: 30/60/90 (manager copyable, measurable):
- 30 days: onboarded to repos & CI, 2 PRs merged (small fixes), attend 3 product discovery sessions, complete security training.
- 60 days: lead one small planning cycle, deliver a scoped spec, ramp to owning one roadmap deliverable, reduce bug backlog by 10% in owned area.
- 90 days: drive a cross-team rollout for a minor feature, propose 2 process improvements, and pass the project handoff checklist.
ting: Add manager-only admin tasks: pre-request elevated access for private repos, add to NDA group, schedule a legal sync on Day 7, and set a private skip-level on week 4.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: intake form must flag "confidential project" and trigger legal + security flows. I'll auto-send invites to #new-hires and #security-training once manager marks the flag.
cass: Can someone draft the 1-page and a calendar ICS bundle? Ill attach to the exec hiring packet. Omar, Ting, can you review by 15:30?
omar: On it.
ting: Will review and confirm IT windows by 15:00.
people-ops-bot: Action items created: 1) Draft exec manager one-pager -> cass, 2) Update intake flag & flows -> people-ops, 3) Pre-provision image and badge pre-approval -> it-ops. Due: today 16:00.
